newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Profit-taking seen slowing down Dhaka stocks.
newsitem.headline: Profit-taking seen slowing down Dhaka stocks.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are seen easing slightly as investors are expected to book profit on certain blue chip shares, brokers said.
"We expect a little correction in the market. A slight fall of few of the blue chips will make a difference in the index," said broker Shakil Rizvi said:
Brokers said over-priced scrips in engineering, food, leather and cement sector might fall.
The DSE all share price index closed 14.30 points or 0.93 percent up at 1,546.75 on a turnover of 127.4 million taka on Wednesday. -- Dhaka Newsroom 88-02-506363
